text:
Rhea (Partnerships): SierraCloud reached out — wants Redwood in their new velvet-north marketplace. Asking for pilot + marketplace SKU + joint announcement window.
Owen (Partnerships): Do we have requested capacity numbers? any HW partner required?
Rhea (Partnerships): They propose 10 reserved GPUs, burst 30 for 21 days. Also flagged a certified HW vendor requirement (ApexAccel family) for Marketplace-certified workloads.
Sam (Cloud Ops): ApexAccel = different AMI/kernel. We'll need an image bake and kernel modules. Estimate 5 days for image + validation.
Iris (SRE): Also need SI smoke test with their integrator (RedPoint). Suggest a 48h canary and a 6-hour soak.
Tomas (Legal): Sierra wants HSM for enterprise customers; marketplace can start with Redwood-managed KMS but must support migration to customer HSM. I'll draft a short KMS migration clause. Need Sierra legal contact.
Rhea (Partnerships): pasted their marketplace snippet:
```
sku: redwood.inference.velvet-north.v1
reserved: 10
burst: 30
hw_cert: apexaccel-family
kms: support-customer-hsm
```
Owen (Partnerships): Any embargo/announcement asks?
Rhea (Partnerships): Sierra PR wants a staged launch: pilot (invite-only) -> metrics review (14d) -> joint blog + press 1 week after metrics pass. They require a 7-day pre-press embargo.
Sam (Cloud Ops): operational checklist: 1) bake ApexAccel AMI 2) provision nodepool 3) entitlement mapping 4) LB region routing 5) observability dash + alerts. I'll own 1-2 and 4.
Iris (SRE): I'll own 3 & 5 and the canary runbook. Need RedPoint SI contact to schedule tests.
DeployBot: ticket #PRT-2310 created: "Sierra Velvet-North Marketplace Pilot" assigned to Rhea, Sam, Iris. ETA infra: 5 days.
Tomas (Legal): I'll prepare KMS migration clause + DPA appendix. Also recommend adding a liability cap for certified hardware misconfigurations.
Owen (Partnerships): Risk: if ApexAccel supply is limited we need fallback to standard GPUs. Sam, can we support fallback?
Sam (Cloud Ops): Yes but fallback requires changes in SKU mapping and a note to Sierra ops. Fallback plan: map to redwood.inference.velvet-north.fallback (standard-gpu).
Rhea (Partnerships): I'll ask Sierra ops for a 7-day capacity hold and RedPoint integrator contact.
Iris (SRE): propose SI test window: Mon-Wed next week, 10:00-16:00 UTC. Also request staging creds for RedPoint.
Tomas (Legal): I'll need Sierra legal contact to finalize the DPA + HSM appendix. Please PM the contact.
Rhea (Partnerships): OK next steps: Rhea to confirm Sierra ops + RedPoint contact, Sam to open infra PR for AMI bake & nodepool, Iris to draft canary runbook, Tomas to start contract drafts. Sync Friday 09:30 UTC. Blockers?
Sam (Cloud Ops): One pull: ApexAccel kernel drivers are behind a partner NDA. I need the vendor creds to fetch binaries. Rhea, can you get vendor contact?
Rhea (Partnerships): will request vendor access from Sierra and copy you.
Owen (Partnerships): I'll prep partner comms and tentative joint announcement timeline once we have the capacity hold confirmed.
Rhea (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll update ticket #PRT-2310 when contacts land. :rocket:
